title: Persisted reader setting 'newspaper' silently resets after newsprint rename

comments.author: home
comments.text:
BUG raised by the agent that did PPY-d79ff2, worth fixing before this ships.

The layout enum value was renamed 'newspaper' -> 'newsprint' (commit f9b073f). amplify/functions/reader-settings/handler.ts now stores and accepts 'newsprint'. Any reader setting ALREADY PERSISTED in DynamoDB as 'newspaper' will no longer match a valid value and will silently fall back to the default.

Silent fallback is the problem - the user's saved preference vanishes with no signal.

SCOPE: decide and implement a migration. Options: accept 'newspaper' as a deprecated alias that normalizes to 'newsprint' on read (simplest, no data migration, recommended); or backfill the stored values; or both. Whatever you choose, cover it with a test that a stored 'newspaper' value still yields newsprint.

NOTE: verify the premise first. Confirm there IS persisted data with the old value before building a migration for a table that may be empty. Report what you find either way.
